questions.question: Who is the Elf lord of Rivendell?
questions.note: He was at the Last Alliance and watched Isildur keep the Ring.

questions.question: What is the name of the sword Bilbo gives Frodo?
questions.note: Bilbo found it on his own adventure.

questions.question: What does Sting do when Orcs are near?
questions.note: Frodo checks it in Moria. It is glowing.

questions.question: What is the light, strong shirt Bilbo gives Frodo made of?
questions.note: It saves Frodo from a cave troll's spear in Moria.

questions.question: Which man of Gondor wants to use the Ring as a weapon?
questions.note: 'Give Gondor the weapon of the Enemy.'

questions.question: What sword did Isildur use to cut the Ring from Sauron's hand?
questions.note: It broke under Sauron. Its shards are kept in Rivendell.

questions.question: Aragorn is the heir of which king?
questions.note: Legolas names him Aragorn, son of Arathorn. Boromir: 'This is Isildur's heir?'

questions.question: Who volunteers at the Council to take the Ring to Mordor?
questions.note: 'I will take it. Though I do not know the way.'

questions.question: How many companions make up the Fellowship?
questions.note: Four hobbits, two men, an Elf, a Dwarf, and a wizard. Nine against the Nine Riders.

questions.question: Which Dwarf joins the Fellowship?
questions.note: Son of Glóin. He tries to smash the Ring with his axe first.
